cardTitle: ANTALYA MODEL DELIVERED TO HUȘI, VASLUI COUNTY
cardSummary: A hand-finished wood-effect exterior, a lakeshore setting, and probably the best-equipped View Box ever built
subPageHeading: ANTALYA MODEL DELIVERED TO HUȘI, VASLUI COUNTY
subPageSubheading: A hand-finished wood-effect exterior, a lakeshore setting, and probably the best-equipped View Box ever built
subPageBody:
Usually, when we talk about customisation, we are talking about colour and furniture.

This delivery is something else.

The View Box Antalya that arrived in Huși, Vaslui County, is probably the most complex and best-equipped configuration we have ever produced: bespoke joinery, skylights, privacy glass, exterior services prepared in advance, and equipment chosen item by item around how the client would actually use the house.

And all of it sits on a lakeshore, under willow trees.

A Hand-Finished Exterior

The exterior is finished in a special wood tone — probably one of the most successful colours we have ever produced for a View Box home.

It is not a standard finish. Many of the details are executed by hand, which is why it represented an upgrade of roughly €2,000 over the standard options.

You see it best up close: the texture runs continuously across the surface, the corners of the house are rounded, and the ventilation grille is integrated into the finish so that it never interrupts the grain.

The result is a house that, in a natural setting, does not read as prefabricated at all.

The Lakeshore and the Terrace Under Construction

The house was installed on a concrete pad, a few metres from the water.

A glazed sliding door roughly 2 metres wide was made specifically for the living area, opening the day zone completely to the outside.

It leads straight onto the terrace currently being built: the steel structure is already in place and extends out over the water.

A pergola was planned in front of the living area, with two dedicated fixing points, and two exterior sockets were fitted at the corners of the house so that future terrace equipment has power without any later intervention.

These are exactly the kind of details that are easy to solve in the factory and very hard to solve once the house is already on site.

Living Area: Skylight, Projector and a JBL Soundbar

The living area was designed as the main space of the house.

  • Skylight, for daylight from above and open sky at night
  • Video projector
  • JBL soundbar worth over €1,000
  • Sofa bed
  • The 2-metre sliding door onto the future terrace

The combination of large glazing, a skylight and a full opening onto the terrace makes the living area work almost as a semi-outdoor space during the warm months.

A Kitchen Equipped Like a Full Home

This is not a scaled-down tiny-house kitchen.

  • Full-size refrigerator
  • Two-zone induction hob
  • Microwave oven
  • Jura espresso machine worth over €2,000
  • Dishwasher
  • Sink with a pull-out spray mixer
  • Bar-style table for roughly four to six people, with additional integrated storage

Here is one of the clearest illustrations of how we work: instead of the washing machine that normally goes in the bathroom, the client asked for a dishwasher, because that matched how the house was actually going to be used.

We did not add it alongside the standard configuration. We replaced it.

Bedroom

The bedroom has its own skylight and its own video projector.

  • Bed with premium mattress
  • Wardrobe
  • Storage
  • Skylight
  • Video projector

Triple Glazing and Privacy Glass

The whole house has triple-glazed windows, with privacy glass added on top.

Integrating privacy glass together with the roughly 2-metre glazed sliding door was the most complex and most expensive part of the configuration — two elements that are straightforward on their own, but that together require joinery made specifically for the job.

It was worth it: complete privacy in a house with very generous glazed surfaces, on an open site beside the water.

How Far View Box Customisation Can Go

This house is probably the best answer we have to the question "how much can a View Box home actually be customised?"

The answer does not stop at colour and furniture. It includes bespoke joinery, skylights, privacy glass, a pergola, exterior services prepared in advance, and premium equipment chosen around the client's lifestyle.

Every one of those decisions was made before anything was built — which is precisely why they could be carried out.

Prefabricated Houses With Superior Insulation and a 50-Year Warranty

One of the reasons why View Box Houses modular homes have become increasingly popular across Europe is their excellent balance between quality, comfort, and energy efficiency.

Our prefabricated houses use advanced insulation systems, premium materials, and modern construction methods that often outperform many traditional buildings in terms of thermal efficiency.

Combined with a galvanized steel structure backed by a 50-year structural warranty, these modular homes are designed to provide comfort, durability, and peace of mind for decades.

Real Projects, Real Results

Like every View Box Houses project, this is not a rendering or a concept.

It is a real house, manufactured, delivered, and installed for a real client in Huși, on the shore of a lake.

The photos show exactly what a capsule house looks like when it is taken all the way: a hand-finished exterior, premium equipment, and a placement designed around the water.

Probably the Best-Equipped View Box Built So Far

Some projects show what a modular home can do.

Others show how far it can be taken.

The Antalya in Huși is the second kind. It is the house we point to when someone asks whether a capsule home can genuinely replace a conventional one.

View Box Houses continues to manufacture and deliver capsule houses, modular homes, and prefabricated houses throughout Europe, creating real projects that people can visit, experience, and enjoy.

cardTitle: WHITE BARCELONA MODEL DELIVERED TO CRAIOVA
cardSummary: 28 sqm, two rooms and space for up to four people — the most compact View Box model with a separate bedroom
subPageHeading: WHITE BARCELONA MODEL DELIVERED TO CRAIOVA
subPageSubheading: 28 sqm, two rooms and space for up to four people — the most compact View Box model with a separate bedroom
subPageBody:
Most of the questions we get about capsule houses come down to one: how many people can actually sleep in there comfortably?

The View Box Barcelona model was created as the answer.

With 28 sqm and two separate rooms, Barcelona is the most compact View Box that can accommodate up to four people — and it is the model we delivered, in white, to Craiova.

Installed by Crane

The house arrived in Craiova fully finished from the factory, transported on a trailer and protected for the journey.

Installation was carried out by crane, straight onto the position prepared in advance.

This is the standard procedure for View Box models: the ground is prepared beforehand, the house arrives complete, and lifting and setting it down takes hours rather than months.

A Separate Bedroom, Designed for Daily Use

The first room is configured as a bedroom.

It includes a bed with mattress and clothes storage — compact, but very well thought out, exactly the kind of solution that makes the difference in a 28 sqm house.

The room has floor sockets, underfloor heating and triple-glazed windows.

The house is also fitted with an inverter heating and cooling system, which means comfort both in winter and through southern Romania's summers.

A Bathroom That Makes No Compromises

The bathroom is one of the reasons the Barcelona model is so well received.

The shower area is generous, and the fittings are the ones you will find across all premium View Box configurations:

  • Smart toilet with UV sanitising light, heated seat with sensor and foot-operated flush
  • 60 litre hot water tank
  • Illuminated, anti-fog mirror
  • Freestanding washbasin
  • Premium finishes

The result is a bathroom that feels closer to a hotel room than to a 28 sqm house.

Open-Plan Living and Kitchen

The second room combines the living area with the kitchen.

The sofa is a sofa bed, which allows extra guests and brings the total capacity of the house to four people.

The kitchen includes:

  • Induction hob
  • Extractor hood
  • Mini-fridge
  • Sink
  • Storage integrated into the units

Why Two Rooms Matter

The difference between a studio and a house with a separate bedroom is not measured in square metres. It is measured in how the space is used.

For a holiday home, it means two couples or a family can share the same space without getting in each other's way.

For a rental unit, it means a significantly higher nightly rate on the same footprint of land.

And for long-term living, it means the living area stays a living area.

Prefabricated Houses With Superior Insulation and a 50-Year Warranty

One of the reasons why View Box Houses modular homes have become increasingly popular across Europe is their excellent balance between quality, comfort, and energy efficiency.

Our prefabricated houses use advanced insulation systems, premium materials, and modern construction methods that often outperform many traditional buildings in terms of thermal efficiency.

Combined with a galvanized steel structure backed by a 50-year structural warranty, these modular homes are designed to provide comfort, durability, and peace of mind for decades.

Real Projects, Real Results

Like every View Box Houses project, this is not a rendering or a concept.

It is a real house, manufactured, delivered, and installed for a real client in the Craiova area.

White Exterior — But Every Barcelona Can Look Different

The house in this delivery was finished in white, a choice that works very well on open, bright sites.

Like every View Box Houses model, Barcelona can be customised — in exterior colour, in layout and in equipment.

Available configurations can be found on the View Box Barcelona product page.

cardTitle: BARCELONA MODEL DELIVERED TO THE BLACK SEA SHORE AT COSTINEȘTI
cardSummary: 28 sqm, a sand colour mixed specifically for the coast, and one of the finest sea views in south-eastern Europe
subPageHeading: BARCELONA MODEL DELIVERED TO THE BLACK SEA SHORE AT COSTINEȘTI
subPageSubheading: 28 sqm, a sand colour mixed specifically for the coast, and one of the finest sea views in south-eastern Europe
subPageBody:
Some houses are built around space.

View Box Houses were designed around the view.

This delivery proves it better than any other: a 28 sqm View Box Barcelona placed directly on the shore at Costinești, a short walk from the famous Costinești shipwreck and right next to the new Nibiru resort.

From the living area window you see the sea and the wreck. That is the whole brief.

A Colour Mixed Specifically for the Coast

The exterior of this house is not a catalogue colour.

The client asked for a very pale yellow, close to the colour of sand, so that the house would not contrast with the landscape but appear to belong to it.

The result is clearest in the afternoon light: the house takes on exactly the same colour temperature as the beach behind it.

It is a good illustration of what customisation actually means at View Box Houses — not picking from a palette, but mixing a colour for one specific site.

The Road to the Sea

The house travelled to Costinești on a trailer, fully finished in the factory.

The final kilometres along the seafront, with the water on one side and the sand-coloured house on the platform, explain the project better than any description.

Final placement was carried out by crane that same afternoon, straight onto the prepared position.

A Layout Adapted to the Client

The standard Barcelona comes with two rooms and a sofa bed in the living area.

For this project, the client wanted something different.

The sofa bed was dropped entirely and replaced with proper beds in both rooms.

  • The first room is configured mainly as a bedroom, with a bed and dedicated storage.
  • The second room combines a sleeping area with the kitchen.

It is a layout designed for real seaside use, where the number of beds matters more than a textbook separation between living room and bedroom.

The Kitchen

The kitchen area is fully functional and integrated into the second room:

  • Mini-fridge
  • Induction hob
  • Extractor hood
  • Dedicated kitchen storage

Comfort and Insulation for Life by the Sea

The house has underfloor heating and triple-glazed windows.

On the coast, where day and night temperatures differ significantly and the season can stretch well beyond summer, those two elements are the difference between a summer-only rental and a unit that works almost all year.

View Box Barcelona — 28 sqm, Two Rooms, Up to Four People

Barcelona is the most compact View Box model with two separate rooms that can accommodate up to four people.

For a coastal landowner or a tourism investor, that means a complete accommodation unit with its own bathroom and kitchen, installed in a matter of hours, with no building site and no conventional construction.

Prefabricated Houses With Superior Insulation and a 50-Year Warranty

One of the reasons why View Box Houses modular homes have become increasingly popular across Europe is their excellent balance between quality, comfort, and energy efficiency.

Our prefabricated houses use advanced insulation systems, premium materials, and modern construction methods that often outperform many traditional buildings in terms of thermal efficiency.

Combined with a galvanized steel structure backed by a 50-year structural warranty, these modular homes are designed to provide comfort, durability, and peace of mind for decades.

Real Projects, Real Results

Like every View Box Houses project, this is not a rendering or a concept.

It is a real house, manufactured, delivered, and installed for a real client, on the shore of the Black Sea.

The photos from this delivery show exactly what a capsule house designed around a view looks like.

A Region Made for Houses Like This

Costinești is changing. The new Nibiru resort has brought a different kind of tourism to the area, and land near the seafront has suddenly become very interesting for small-scale accommodation.

These are precisely the sites View Box Houses were designed for: locations where the view is the main argument, and where conventional construction is either too slow or too complicated.

cardTitle: LONDON MODEL DELIVERED TO SÂNGEORZ-BĂI, ROMANIA
cardSummary: A second View Box home for the same client — and one of the most demanding installations we have ever carried out
subPageHeading: LONDON MODEL DELIVERED TO SÂNGEORZ-BĂI, ROMANIA
subPageSubheading: A second View Box home for the same client — and one of the most demanding installations we have ever carried out
subPageBody:
The strongest proof of quality is not a review.

It is a client who comes back and orders again.

This View Box London model, finished in a warm brown, was delivered to the same property in Sângeorz-Băi, Bistrița-Năsăud, where we had previously installed a spruce-green Madeira model.

The space had already been prepared. Today the two houses stand side by side, in the middle of the forest.

A Delivery That Required a Forestry Tractor, a 130-Tonne Crane and a Lift Over the Treetops

Getting to this location was, without exaggeration, one of the hardest logistical challenges in our delivery history.

The access road climbed a very steep gradient, and the bends were far too tight for a truck-and-trailer combination.

On the steepest sections, a forestry skidder was needed to help pull the truck uphill.

In the bends, the truck simply had no room to turn. The solution was a crane that physically repositioned the rear of the trailer, corner after corner, until the whole assembly could pass.

For the final placement we used a 130-tonne crane, which arrived with a separate truck carrying its counterweights and auxiliary equipment.

The house was lifted over the tops of the spruce trees and set down roughly 25 metres from the lifting point, exactly where the client wanted it.

This is the kind of operation that takes days to plan and a single afternoon to execute.

Brown Exterior, LED Pergola and Tinted Glazing

The brown finish was chosen to complement the existing spruce-green Madeira and to let the whole ensemble settle naturally into the forest.

At the client's request, the house was delivered with a custom pergola with LED lighting, positioned above the living area.

The windows are triple-glazed and tinted — a combination that delivers thermal performance, privacy and a very clean exterior look at the same time.

In the evening, the illuminated outline of the house transforms the site completely. That is the moment when it becomes obvious why this model works so well in a forest.

Living Area: A Premium Sofa Bed and a Table for Four to Six

The living area was designed around hosting.

The bar-style table seats roughly four to six people, and storage is built directly into the furniture.

The sofa is a premium upgrade worth over €1,000. It is not an ordinary pull-out: when opened it has an integrated mattress, turning into a proper bed.

In practice, the living area becomes a second sleeping zone with no compromise in comfort.

A video projector completes the relaxation area.

A Fully Equipped Kitchen With a Built-In Miele Fridge

The kitchen is integrated into the living area and fully functional:

  • Two-zone induction hob
  • Extractor hood
  • Built-in Miele refrigerator
  • Storage designed for everyday use

Bedroom and Bathroom

The bedroom includes a bed with mattress and dedicated storage.

The bathroom offers a generous shower area, the smart toilet featured across all View Box configurations, and a washer-dryer — a detail that matters enormously in a rental unit.

Underfloor heating keeps the house comfortable year-round, including in winter at altitude.

Prefabricated Houses With Superior Insulation and a 50-Year Warranty

One of the reasons why View Box Houses modular homes have become increasingly popular across Europe is their excellent balance between quality, comfort, and energy efficiency.

Our prefabricated houses use advanced insulation systems, premium materials, and modern construction methods that often outperform many traditional buildings in terms of thermal efficiency.

Combined with a galvanized steel structure backed by a 50-year structural warranty, these modular homes are designed to provide comfort, durability, and peace of mind for decades.

Real Projects, Real Results

Like every View Box Houses project, this is not a rendering or a concept.

It is a real house, manufactured, delivered, and installed for a real client — the second View Box unit on the same property.

The photos show exactly what modern modular construction can achieve when combined with a spectacular location and a client who knows their project inside out.

Two View Box Homes, One Forest

What began with a single Madeira has grown into a small compound.

Two premium capsule houses standing a few metres apart in a spruce forest in Bistrița-Năsăud, each with its own bedroom, bathroom and living area.

For the owner, that means double the guest capacity with no conventional construction and no building site.

For us, it means the first house did its job.

View Box Houses continues to manufacture and deliver capsule houses, modular homes, and prefabricated houses throughout Europe, creating real projects that people can visit, experience, and enjoy.

cardTitle: FLOATING VILLAGE PROJECT IN MAMAIA, ROMANIA
cardSummary: One of the Most Ambitious Capsule House Projects We Have Ever Delivered And One Of The Most Ambitious Projects In The World
subPageHeading: FLOATING VILLAGE PROJECT IN MAMAIA, ROMANIA
subPageSubheading: One of the Most Ambitious Capsule House Projects We Have Ever Delivered And One Of The Most Ambitious Projects In The World
subPageBody:
Every now and then, a project comes along that completely changes the way people think about modular construction.

This project in Mamaia, Romania, is one of them. We have delivered the first 2 houses, part in a project of 50+ houses. Madeira & Amalfi start the party.

Located on the Romanian seaside, this development is not simply another modular housing project. It is part of a much larger vision: the creation of an entire floating village built using luxury capsule houses.

The project currently includes a brown Madeira model and an Amalfi model, both installed directly on specially designed floating platforms.

From the moment you first see the houses floating on the water, you realize this is something different.

Something that very few people have ever seen before.

A Village That Floats on Water

Most capsule houses are installed on foundations.

Some are installed on pillars.

These houses float.

The concept behind this project is both innovative and ambitious. Instead of developing a traditional holiday village on land, the owner chose to create a floating accommodation experience directly on the water.

The result is extraordinary.

Guests will soon be able to sleep, relax, and enjoy life surrounded by water while experiencing all the comfort of a luxury modular home.

The feeling is completely different from traditional accommodation.

Every sunrise, every sunset, every reflection on the water becomes part of the experience.

Innovative Engineering Behind the Project

Creating a floating village requires much more than simply placing a house on a pontoon.

Every detail has been carefully planned.

The floating platforms have been designed to support the houses while also integrating essential utility systems.

The left floating platform is used for sewage water storage and management.

The right floating platform is used for fresh water storage and supply.

This allows the houses to function as fully operational accommodation units while maintaining the flexibility and uniqueness of a floating structure.

It is a remarkable example of how engineering and architecture can work together to create something truly special.

Luxury Accommodation on Water

Although the location is unique, the comfort remains exactly what guests expect from View Box Houses.

The Madeira and Amalfi models are fully equipped and include:

  • Modern kitchens
  • Comfortable living spaces
  • Fully equipped bathrooms
  • Furnished bedrooms
  • Premium mattresses
  • Smart storage solutions
  • High-quality finishes
  • Large glazed surfaces for panoramic views

Everything was designed to provide the same level of comfort found in premium hospitality projects on land.

The difference is that here, guests wake up surrounded by water.

A New Type of Tourism Experience

Modern travelers are looking for experiences that cannot be found everywhere.

They want something memorable.

Something unique.

This floating village offers exactly that.

Instead of simply booking a room, guests become part of a completely different environment where architecture, water, and nature come together to create an unforgettable stay.

Projects like this demonstrate how capsule houses and modular homes can be used far beyond traditional residential applications.

Real Projects, Real Innovation

At View Box Houses, we believe that innovation only matters when it becomes reality.

This is not a concept.

It is not a rendering.

It is not a future idea.

It is a real project that has been manufactured, delivered, and installed.

The photos and videos show exactly what has been achieved and what guests will soon be able to experience.

One of the Most Unique Projects in Our Portfolio

Among all the projects delivered by View Box Houses across Europe, this floating village in Mamaia stands out as one of the most innovative and exciting.

The combination of floating architecture, luxury capsule houses, seaside views, and tourism development creates something truly special.

It is more than a housing project.

It is more than a tourism project.

It is the beginning of an entirely new way of experiencing modular living.

View Box Houses continues to manufacture and deliver capsule houses, modular homes, and prefabricated buildings throughout Europe, transforming ambitious ideas into real projects that people can see, visit, and experience.
